 Inside Harry Kane’s £2.7 Million Watch Collection: Rare Rolex, Patek Philippe and the £1 million Daytona he wore at the Ballon d’Or

 Print Inside Harry Kane’s £2.7 Million Watch Collection: Rare Rolex, Patek Philippe and the £1 Million Daytona He Wore at the Ballon d’Or Harry Kane is known for scoring goals for Bayern Munich and England, but the football star has also caught the attention of luxury watch fans with his expensive timepieces. His collection includes rare watches from Patek Philippe, Rolex, and Audemars Piguet, with some pieces worth hundreds of thousands of pounds. The biggest headline came at the 2026 Ballon d’Or ceremony in Paris, where Kane wore a rare Rolex Cosmograph Daytona valued at around £1 million. According to a recent watch collection estimate, the footballer’s publicly identified timepieces are worth approximately £2.7 million, although the actual value remains unconfirmed. Which Rolex watch did Harry Kane wear at the 2026 Ballon d’Or ceremony?
 Kane attracted attention at the 2026 Ballon d’Or ceremony with a rare Rolex Cosmograph Daytona, reference 126599TSA, known as the Blue Sapphire. The watch is made from white gold and features 36 baguette-cut blue sapphires around the bezel, along with 11 blue-sapphire hour markers. Its silver-sheen obsidian dial gives the timepiece a distinctive look. The watch is not a standard model from Rolex’s regular collection. It is an off-catalogue piece, meaning it is not part of the brand’s usual publicly available range. This rarity, combined with its precious materials and gemstone setting, helps explain its reported value of around £1 million, or approximately $1.3 million to $1.4 million. The price is an estimate reported by watch specialists and collectors rather than an official valuation from Rolex or Kane himself. The actual amount the watch could command would depend on its provenance, condition, and the market for rare luxury watches. Kane’s Ballon d’Or appearance also highlighted the growing interest in the watches worn by elite footballers. Their timepieces often attract attention alongside their outfits, particularly when they feature rare references or precious stones. The Blue Sapphire Daytona stands out as the most expensive publicly identified watch associated with Kane in recent reports. However, it is only one part of a collection that includes several high-value Patek Philippe models and other Rolex watches. Why does Harry Kane’s Patek Philippe watch collection attract attention?
 Patek Philippe appears to be the main focus of Kane’s documented watch collection. The Swiss luxury watchmaker is known for its complicated mechanical movements, limited production, and high-end materials, making its watches popular among collectors. One of Kane’s most notable pieces is the Patek Philippe Grand Complications 5470P-001. The platinum watch features a blue dial and a split-seconds chronograph, a mechanism that allows the wearer to measure separate intervals of time. Kane wore it during his Bayern Munich unveiling in 2023, bringing attention to a timepiece that has been valued at hundreds of thousands of pounds. Reported estimates for the 5470P-001 vary. Some watch roundups have placed its value at approximately £416,690, while earlier coverage by GQ suggested a figure as high as £750,000. These differences show why watch prices should be treated carefully, particularly when a model is rare and estimates come from different sources. Kane has also been linked to the Patek Philippe Grand Complications 5271P-010, valued at around £273,890, and the 5270P-014, estimated at approximately £200,000. Both watches add to the high-end mechanical side of his collection. His other reported Patek Philippe watches include the Cubitus 5822P-001, which he wore at the 2025 Spanish Grand Prix, and the Complications 5935A-001, which he wore during an appearance on Good Morning America in 2023. Their reported values are around £80,000 and £60,000, respectively. Kane has also been associated with the Patek Philippe Aquanaut 5168G-010, valued at approximately £46,730. Together, these watches show his interest in models that combine luxury materials with advanced watchmaking. Which other Rolex and Audemars Piguet watches does Harry Kane own?
 Alongside Patek Philippe, Rolex makes up another important part of Kane’s publicly documented watch collection. Some of his most recognisable pieces include special editions of the Cosmograph Daytona. During England’s opening match against Iran at the 2022 FIFA World Cup, Kane wore the Rolex Daytona Rainbow, reference 116595RBOW. The Everose-gold watch features a bezel set with coloured sapphires and a diamond-set dial. Its colourful design makes it stand out from the more traditional Daytona models. Estimates of the Rainbow Daytona’s value vary considerably across watch publications. One recent roundup placed it at around £75,000, while other sources have cited higher figures. Its value depends on the specific model, market conditions, and whether the price refers to retail or resale value. Kane has also been linked to the Rolex Daytona Le Mans, reference 126528LN, with an estimated value of around £150,000. Another reported piece is the Rolex Day-Date 36 Puzzle, a distinctive model that replaces conventional day and date displays with colourful words and symbols. His collection is not limited to Rolex and Patek Philippe. Kane has also been photographed wearing an Audemars Piguet Royal Oak, another well-known luxury watch design. Earlier reports have additionally associated him with a rose-gold Patek Philippe Nautilus Chronograph 5980/1R-001 and a Patek Philippe Split-Seconds Chronograph 5370P. However, photographs of a watch worn by a celebrity do not always confirm ownership. Unless Kane or a reliable source has established that a particular piece belongs to him, it is more accurate to describe it as a watch he has been seen wearing or one associated with his collection. What is the estimated value of Harry Kane’s entire watch collection?
 A detailed October 2026 watch roundup estimated the value of Kane’s publicly identified watch collection at approximately £2.7 million. The reported total includes the £1 million Rolex Blue Sapphire Daytona, several high-value Patek Philippe watches, and other Rolex models. Join conversation

 The Blue Sapphire Daytona accounts for a substantial share of that estimate. The Patek Philippe Grand Complications watches also contribute significantly because of their precious-metal cases, complicated movements, and reported market values. Kane’s publicly identified timepieces reveal a collection built around some of the biggest names in luxury watchmaking. His Patek Philippe Grand Complications models highlight an interest in technical watchmaking, while the gemstone-set Rolex Daytona and Rainbow Daytona offer more striking designs. For fans of luxury watches, Kane’s collection provides a glimpse into the expensive timepieces associated with one of football’s most recognisable strikers. While the reported £2.7 million value remains an estimate, his rare Rolex and Patek Philippe watches have made his collection an interesting subject for both football followers and watch enthusiasts.
